messages:
Jordan: Quick thread — propose slimming the autoscaler ↔ operator API for dedicated GPU pools. The current payload carries full forecast blobs; that's causing tight coupling.
Marta: Agreed. We talked about intent vs plan in the RFC but didn't land on exact fields.
Jordan: Proposal: operator only needs 'scale_intent' objects: {target_gpu_count, headroom_tokens, evict_grace_sec, priority_band}. All other details live in control plane.
Kevin: Curious about warmup hints — do you want a separate 'prewarm' field or embed into headroom_tokens? @Marta?
Marta: separate 'prewarm_profile' makes rollout easier. Small enum: NONE, LAZY, HOT, CUSTOM (refers to id).
Priya: Observability ask: can operator emit 'intent_accepted' and 'intent_rejected' metrics with labels for tenant & reason? We need hooks for per-tenant latency/cost correlation.
Jordan: yes — include an 'observability' section with sparse hooks: metric_labels[], trace_id optional. Operator only emits events, not metrics aggregation.
infra-bot: deploy-checklist — remember to add backcompat layer mapping old forecast -> new scale_intent until rollout complete.
Kevin: What about admission semantics when scale_intent is partially fulfilled (e.g., only hot nodes) — we should add 'fulfillment_type' enum in status: FULL, PARTIAL, QUEUED.
Marta: Implementation note: keep JSON small — don't ship full topology. Use references to pool-id and prewarm-profile-id.
Jordan: I'll draft a small proto and a migration shim. TL;DR: intent-based, prewarm_profile enum, observability hooks, fulfillment status. Thoughts?
Priya: +1. Can you include a short example intent?
Jordan:
```json
{"pool_id":"dedicated-eu-west-1a","target_gpu_count":12,"headroom_tokens":3,"prewarm_profile":"HOT","evict_grace_sec":120}
```
Marta: Looks good. Add note about rate-limiting intents (1/min) to avoid oscillation. Also add canary header for rollout.
Jordan: Great — will put up an RFC follow-up PR and ping infra for the shim.
Kevin: Thanks. :+1:
